Sacrifices an adjacent friendly Goblin; gains +1 Attack, Defense and Morale each (max +5) until the battle ends; casts +1 (in H5: restores 2 x Goblin Hit Points of mana, can exceed the maximum). Unlimited uses.

{Seduce}

Takes control of an enemy stack that is not immune to Mind spells (same effect as Puppet Master) for rounds = Succubus Seducers' total Hit Points / target's total Hit Points (rounded down, must be at least 1, max 10). Once per battle.

{Set Snares}

Places a trap invisible to the enemy on a hex (only one at a time; placing another moves it), and enemies stepping on it stop. (In H5, it had a chance to stop them or shorten their movement, and on failure the trapper's ATB was reset; in this version they always stop.) Unlimited uses.

{Siphon Mana}

In H5 it steals Vermin / 8 (rounded up) mana from the enemy hero and splits it evenly among your spellcasting stacks. This version approximates it: each of your other spellcasting stacks gets +1 cast, and the target (an enemy spellcasting stack) gets -1 cast. Once per battle.

{Symbiosis}

One friendly Treant stack regains 17 x Dryads Hit Points (can resurrect, permanent), and the Dryads themselves regain 3 x Dryads Hit Points (20 and 4 in H5, converted to equivalent Hit Points). Any range. Once per battle.
